text.Un laboratorio aperto per riportare in v: An open laboratory for reviving legacy PCs: CPU analysis, instruction-set limitations, Live operating systems and reproducible findings. No impossible promises.
text.Una seconda vita per il vecchio hardware: Giving old hardware a second life.
text.Un Core 2 Duo T5670, circa 3 GiB di RAM: A Core 2 Duo T5670, around 3 GiB of RAM and Windows 10 32-bit already running. Next: a 64-bit Linux Live test without installing anything on the internal drive.
text.Dalla generazione del processore ci aspe: Based on the processor generation, POPCNT and SSE4.2 are expected to be absent. CPUID has not yet been measured on this specific device.
text.Identificazione riportata da Windows, no: Device name reported by Windows; not verified
text.La dimensione rilevata non prova la capa: The reported size does not prove the physical storage capacity. No conversion, formatting or repartitioning before a backup.
text.Dall'inventario all'avvio Live: From hardware inventory to Live boot
text.Un risultato negativo è un risultato uti: A negative result is still valuable: we document limitations and issues rather than pretending unsupported configurations work.
text.Demo statica · Nessuna scansione reale d: Static demo · No real scan of the visitor's hardware
text.Rileviamo CPU, RAM, BIOS e storage con s: We identify CPU, RAM, BIOS and storage using non-invasive probes and anonymized reports.
text.Separiamo x64, POPCNT, SSE4.2 e i vincol: We distinguish x64, POPCNT, SSE4.2 and OS limitations from installer-only restrictions.
text.Test da USB, risultati ripetibili, nessu: USB-based testing, reproducible results and no changes to the internal disk during initial diagnostics.
text.Open core sotto AGPLv3. Nessuna ISO Wind: The public core is licensed under AGPLv3. No Windows ISOs, Microsoft DLLs or kernel patches are distributed.
text.Ricerca sperimentale indipendente. Non a: Independent experimental research. Not affiliated with HP, Intel or Microsoft.
